title: Moon Meaning
overview: The Moon describes emotional needs, instinctive reactions, memory, body rhythms, caretaking patterns, and what helps a person feel safe enough to respond rather than defend. It shows the private self: how feelings move, how comfort is sought, and what kind of environment supports steadiness.
cycle: The Moon travels through the zodiac in about 27.3 days and changes signs roughly every two to two and a half days. Its sign describes emotional style; its house shows where the person seeks safety, familiarity, and nourishment.

signs.body: Moon in Aries feels quickly and responds directly. Emotional safety comes through autonomy, honest action, and the freedom to move instead of waiting for permission.
Moon in Taurus seeks emotional steadiness through comfort, touch, routine, and reliable surroundings. Feelings settle when life feels simple, embodied, and materially secure.
Moon in Gemini processes feelings through language, movement, curiosity, and mental variety. Emotional regulation often comes from naming the feeling and talking it through.
Moon in Cancer is deeply responsive, protective, and tied to home, memory, and belonging. Emotional safety comes through care, privacy, and trusted bonds.
Moon in Leo needs warmth, affection, play, and heartfelt recognition. Feelings want expression, and emotional safety grows when joy and loyalty are present.
Moon in Virgo processes emotions through order, usefulness, observation, and practical care. Safety comes from rhythm, repair, and knowing what can be done next.
Moon in Libra seeks emotional balance through harmony, fairness, beauty, and relational attunement. Safety grows when conflict can be addressed without losing respect.
Moon in Scorpio feels intensely and needs emotional honesty, privacy, and trust. Safety comes from depth, loyalty, and the freedom to name what is usually hidden.
Moon in Sagittarius needs freedom, movement, humor, meaning, and room to breathe. Emotional safety grows when life still feels open and the story can keep expanding.
Moon in Capricorn seeks emotional safety through competence, structure, responsibility, and self-command. Feelings may be private, but they are not absent.
Moon in Aquarius needs space, perspective, friendship, and respect for individuality. Emotional safety grows when feelings can be understood without being crowded.

Moon in Pisces feels through empathy, imagination, atmosphere, and spiritual sensitivity. Safety comes through gentleness, creative release, and boundaries that keep compassion from becoming overwhelm.
